review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains only theorems, with no @[simp] declarations, no new definitions and no simp-set manipulation. The simp calls are local and terminal: `simpa using hAmax`, `simp only [one_mul] at ht`, and `simpa only [mul_zero, zero_add]`. The one candidate was `hotLateBoxMass_eq_physical`, which unfolds the definition `hotLateBoxMass` into a `positiveDensityMeasure` expression. It needs the measurability hypothesis `hf`, and other files use `hotLateBoxMass` as an opaque quantity, for example in CapAnnularMassGrowth and LocalizedHotMassGrowth. Making it a simp lemma would expand every use of `hotLateBoxMass` and could not discharge `hf` automatically. The rubric also warns against adding simp attributes only because an identity looks simple. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, competing rule, bad orientation, unwanted expansion or credible cycle. I did not inspect the imported files exhaustively for existing simp lemmas about `scaledBoxMass` or `awayKineticBox`.
